electricity_kwh_total.description: Total electricity consumption in kWh across all facilities and the full reporting period

gas_kwh_total.description: Total natural gas consumption in kWh across all facilities

fuel_litres_total.description: Total fuel consumed in litres (diesel, petrol, LPG combined)

scope1_kgco2e.description: Scope 1 direct greenhouse gas emissions in kgCO2e from fuel combustion

scope2_kgco2e.description: Scope 2 indirect greenhouse gas emissions from purchased electricity in kgCO2e

total_ghg_tco2e.description: Total Scope 1 plus Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions in tCO2e

energy_intensity_kwh_per_employee.description: Energy intensity: total energy kWh divided by number of employees

emission_intensity_kgco2e_per_employee.description: GHG emission intensity: total kgCO2e divided by number of employees

electricity_yoy_pct.description: Year-on-year percentage change in electricity consumption

emissions_yoy_pct.description: Year-on-year percentage change in total greenhouse gas emissions

headcount.description: Total number of employees at reporting date

lost_time_injury_rate.description: Lost-time injury frequency rate per 1,000,000 hours worked

training_hours_per_employee.description: Average training hours per employee during the reporting year

board_independence_pct.description: Percentage of independent non-executive board members

whistleblower_cases.description: Number of whistleblower or ethics hotline cases reported

water_consumption_m3_total.description: Total water consumption in cubic meters (m3)
